scope: native Win32 input through the escape-route runtime and inventory controllers
checks: single click selects without mutating inventory
right-click opens rifle actions and targets a different item without closing case
double-click equips the exact selected firearm once
double-click equips the starting knife through the same action path
split quantity opens, cancels safely and confirms without changing total quantity
drag starts past the threshold and right-click cancels without opening a menu or mutating
release outside both panels cancels without world Drop
keyboard context and Enter use the same exact-item action resolver
double-click transfers a storage stack to backpack and stores a player stack back
weapon Store/Take preserves the exact instance and loaded rounds
context Unload returns every loaded rifle round and receives an accepted acknowledgement
Drop quantity cancel is harmless; WM_CHAR 1 then Enter drops exactly one round and is acknowledged
limitations: This input automation does not establish visual quality or human UX acceptance.
